diceBot.title: Dice bot
diceBot.intro:
[Dice bot] Type dice expressions in chat to roll dice.
Input example) 2d6+1 attack!
Output example) 2d6+1 attack!
              diceBot: (2d6) → 7
You can also include a dice expression followed by a space and additional text.

Usage examples
  3D6+1>=9 : Roll 3d6+1 and check whether the total is 9 or more.
  1D100<=50 : D100 downward roll with target value 50.
  3U6[5] : Roll 3d6 with reroll on 5+ (open-ended above).
  3B6 : Roll 3d6 and output values separately (no sum).
  10B6>=4 : Roll 10d6 and count dice with value 4+.
  2R6[>3]>=5 : Reroll dice >3 then count dice with value 5+.
  (8/2)D(4+6)<=(5*3) : Arithmetic is allowed in count/sides/target.
  c(10-4*3/2+2) : c(expression) evaluates math only.
  choice[a,b,c] : Pick one element at random.
  S3d6 : Prefix S for a secret roll (others cannot see).
  3d6/2 : Divide the result (rounding depends on system). Use /2C (ceil), /2R (round), /2F (floor).
  D66 : D66 die. Order depends on the system: D66N (raw), D66A (ascending), D66D (descending).

For full details see the bcdice command guide:
https://docs.bcdice.org/
===================================
